name: authoring_chain_stream_loop
description: Iterates over the stream of responses generated by the authoring chain.

name: customer_assistance_request
description: The user request string that specifies the content of the response to be generated.
full_code: "Write a customer assistance response on the positioning of Student Loans as it relates to low income students."

name: recursion_limit_dict
description: A dictionary containing parameters for the authoring chain, specifically setting the recursion limit.

name: print_response
description: Prints each response from the authoring chain to the console.

name: print_separator
description: Prints a separator line to the console for better readability of output.

name: end_check
description: Checks if the current response indicates the end of the stream.
